name: Godstouched Focus
body:
Your cursed blessing becomes stronger.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 16, Godstouched, level 11+.

Benefit: You add 5 to your effective oracle level for the purposes of determining the effects of the curse you gained with the Godstouched feat.
